verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents `humanlayer automation run`, which runs a single session on demand. Any recurring behavior comes from an external scheduler such as a cron machine or CI job, which is a user-side or host-platform workaround rather than the product's own capability. The evidence shows no native recurring schedule, cron trigger, or scheduled-workflow feature, so a one-off run is not credited as recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
